exams.notes: Proctored; written, written and oral, oral, or computerized as approved by the board; includes provisions of the National Electrical Code. No cap on number of attempts, but applicant must re-apply after one year if not passed.
exams.quote: Proctored examinations shall be written, written and oral, oral, or computerized as approved by the board. They shall include such provisions of the National Electrical Code as the board may deem appropriate.

qualifier_required.quote: The office may issue a license to corporations and partnerships engaged in the business of making electrical installations, provided that one or more officers or employees of any such corporation directly in charge of the business affairs of such corporation, or a member of such partnership directly in charge of its business affairs, is a licensed master electrician.
